reported_failure: Screen coupon did not pass size or alignment

independent_drawing_review.cause: Ear R2.10 was incorrectly applied as an offset to the hole centers. Hole centers are on the two straight PCB datum lines, not outside them.

affected_designs: C1 inherited the same incorrect mounting and window definition; no C1 physical fit accepted
axial_failure: Side photograph shows a large gap between the bezel and panel. Original 14 mm ear-seat depth was selected from overall module thickness rather than measured front projection.
limits: Photographs establish the reported fit failure and visible gaps. No exact as-built dimensions are extracted from perspective photographs.
measurement_requested: LCD PCB front surface to front metal-bezel surface; do not infer from the 13.5 mm maximum overall module thickness
